initial_query: Find an existing residential dwelling to convert it into a micro-nursery for 18 children in Turin with at least 140 sqm of gross floor area in energy class C or better near public transport.
submitted_query: Find an existing residential dwelling to convert it into a micro-nursery for 18 children in Turin with at least 140 sqm of gross floor area in energy class C or better near public transport.
